name: 09-netcheck
teaches: drt netcheck answers with one of four verdicts and the evidence that produced it. The decisive measurement is the UDP mapping across two STUN servers, so with none given — or with one, which is not a comparison — it reports 'not measured', falls back to relay, and exits non-zero.
cmd: echo '$ drt netcheck'; drt netcheck; echo "exit $?"; echo; echo '$ drt netcheck --stun stun.l.google.com:19302'; drt netcheck --stun stun.l.google.com:19302; echo "exit $?"
